text: Picked this keyboard up used for 38. Knew 38 doesn't get you a pristine board, didn't get one. Spacebar rattles on a lot of presses, not every, but I catch it in the silence right before I start writing out a sentence. One key ghosts randomly, type a word it comes out doubled, so just reread everything before I hit send. That habit has saved me from a few mistakes but honestly wish I had to learn it on my own, not the board that forced me. Asked the seller what switches are on here, got answer week later, by then I'd already taken it, figured out feel on my own, so whatever. Keeping it mostly because it's comfortable enough to use, I write emails long enough that I stop noticing my hands on it and they don't tire out after an hour. Switches have a weight, a feel that's nice. Considered returning it, but the rattle isn't bothering me that bad, it's not bad enough, just the fact of having to deal with the return, that's a hassle, so here it stays.
